item.title: Rave: Rate My Professors Matters
item.description: Starting a new college class can feel like a gamble when you know nothing about the professor. Perspectives Staff Writer Hana Wadlow explains why students turn to Rate My Professors and how to use it wisely. The post Rave: Rate My Professors Matters appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: SGA Passes Resolution, Discusses New Committees
item.description: SGA passed a new resolution, discussed the upcoming town hall, and addressed committees. SGA members said they are concerned about awareness and visibility. The post SGA Passes Resolution, Discusses New Committees appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Seniors Take Steps Toward Post-Grad Life
item.description: As seniors prepare to graduate, many describe their feelings on this new chapter as both intimidating and exciting. Students reflect on their time at Pepperdine while navigating a tough job market and facing tough life decisions. The post Seniors Take Steps Toward Post-Grad Life appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Trial Date Still Not Set for Fraser Michael Bohm
item.description: A trial date was not set at the Feb. 10 pre-trial hearing for Fraser Michael Bohm. The defense suggested the first two weeks of June for a trial start date. The post Trial Date Still Not Set for Fraser Michael Bohm appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Opinion: Expectations Can Set Us Up for Failure
item.description: Expectations tend to be an inevitable part of life, especially in college. Perspectives Staff Writer Eva Shauriki argues expectations can be dangerous and can lead to negative outcomes. The post Opinion: Expectations Can Set Us Up for Failure appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: A Rite of Passage: Waves Hike to the Cross For Pepperdine’s Best View
item.description: Students hike to the cross for a panoramic view of campus, the ocean and the surrounding mountains. The trail has become more than a physical climb — it is a rite of passage that blends tradition, community and beauty. The post A Rite of Passage: Waves Hike to the Cross For Pepperdine’s Best View appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Opinion: The Return of Rom-Coms is Restoring Emotional Intelligence
item.description: Romantic comedy is a movie genre beloved for its light-hearted, playful nature. Perspectives Staff Writer Alyssa Hunnicutt argues interest in rom-coms is on the rise and reviving emotional intelligence. The post Opinion: The Return of Rom-Coms is Restoring Emotional Intelligence appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Men’s Basketball Falls 88-60 at Saint Mary’s
item.description: Pepperdine Men's Basketball fell 88-60 at Saint Mary's on Wednesday, Feb. 11 at the University Credit Union Pavilion in Moraga, Calif. Aaron Clark led the Waves on offense, finishing with 18 points. The post Men’s Basketball Falls 88-60 at Saint Mary’s appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: SGA Launches Committees
item.description: Student Government Association (SGA) launched committees in lieu of the next meeting, where members of the University administration were present. SGA hosted Kent Syler, an MTSU professor and veteran campaign manager, as guest speaker. The post SGA Launches Committees appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Abroad in Milan: Students Share Perspectives on Pepperdine’s Milan Winter Olympics Program
item.description: A group of students is studying abroad in Milan as part of a six-week program, which emphasizes the marketing and advertising side of the Olympic Games. The program brings an immersive learning experience and valuable connections for student participants.
